summary: Rooms and suites are being redesigned by Tara Bernerd and three new dining concepts by Humbert & Poyet. GM Vincent Poulingue has been in post since 18 May. No completion date published.
title: Mandarin Oriental, Paris begins a full transformation while staying open
why: A live case study in repositioning a Rue Saint-Honoré icon without closing.
